title: When the Playlist Wakes
author: Oscar Thornbury
blurb: Orsen Ashgrove, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
